title: Great tour with Miguel
text: I visited Seville in July and had a wonderful tour with Miguel. He's very knowledgeable and has a great sense of humor! I would recommend this tour to anyone.
author: Fae1983

title: Great tour
text: Lina took us around the main spots in the city center. She was knowledgeable and good fun. She kept spirits high in spite of the endless rain!
author: Alex B

title: Free walking tour with Lina
text:
Today I took the free walking tour through the beautiful city of Sevilla. The tour, given by Lina, was great. A lot of the history of the city was explained during the 2 hours in a simple yet straight to the point way. And the guide was very enthusiastic about the topic, which made it more engaging for the tourists and much more interesting.
Thanks again for the tour Lina!

- Ricardo from Puerto Rico
author: ricky93cas

title: Wonderful tour with Lina
text: Lina was incredibly knowledgeable and funny. Throughout our tour she broke down the history of Seville and included fun local myths. The tour is long but gives a great layout of the major sites, as well as a good background for what you are seeing. Lina's English is great, she speaks quickly, but is easy to follow. I highly recommend  a tour with her!
author: Rowan Q

title: A Good Guide
text: Lina was a good walking tour guide. One of the best tours. Amazing tour guide would recommend the guided tours to anyone visiting Seville
author: Francisco V

title: Ok but work on timing
text: Tour was spread into 3 parts with 1-2 hour breaks in between.  Would have appreciated 2 yours together. Otherwise, tour guide was nice.
author: Thedogjumps

title: Too much of a good thing!!!
text: Cathedral was beautiful ! Needed more time for the gardens.  Three tours back to back were too many!  Had to rush thru last tour of the Jewish quarter.
author: Debra_C
